name: Taillard ta41 job-shop makespan
definition: For the fixed Taillard ta41 instance, schedule every operation. Each job follows its own prescribed machine route, and each machine processes at most one operation at a time. Minimize the final completion time (makespan).
solution_format: An object with machine_orders: one permutation of all 30 job indices for each of the 20 machines.
constraints: Every one of the 30 jobs has 20 operations on its prescribed route.
Each machine processes all 30 assigned operations exactly once, without overlap.
Operations within each job follow the fixed route order.
Processing times are positive integers; operations are non-preemptive.
The directed graph formed by job precedence and machine order must be acyclic.
verification: Exact integer longest-path evaluation on the acyclic graph of job precedences and consecutive operations in each machine order. A cycle or invalid machine permutation is rejected.

source_review.definition: Taillard ta41，30工件20机器、每工件各自固定机器顺序、非抢占、最小化makespan。不同机器可用不同工件顺序，与T028 permutation flowshop不同。
source_review.primary_sources: Sol重新下载Taillard官方tai30_20.txt与Shylo公开2006排程HTML，逐字节匹配源快照；全部600个machine/duration操作及20条机器工件排列逐项匹配保存JSON。原始实例SHA256 fa6631f4411187bb1b43e4c444293227852860fa56f3ea6e14f48a294adbd3b9。
source_review.record_and_status: 亲自读取当前optimizizer TA表ta41行，仍列1912–2006，2008传统GES构造2006保存且可复算；2025论文Table5、14给1915是new lower bound而非可行值，结论明确未形式证明其solver下界，故单独记为报告。所查来源未闭合。
source_review.human_baseline: Giffler–Thompson冲突集算法配最长加工时间优先，复现3296；该弱H不冒充最强公开人类2006。实现逐步选最早完成操作对应机器，冲突集取可开始时间小于该完成时间的待选操作。
source_review.independent_math: 正式checker构造前驱DAG后拓扑最长路；Sol另用工件下一操作与机器下一工件双游标逐步dispatch，维护两类ready时间。全部600操作调度完成，独立得相同makespan。
source_review.controls: 初始25114、传统/演化2795、人类3296、参考2006；重复工件破坏、完整声明不变性、严格回放、仅公开instance冷导出、三类运行失败通过。预算metadata初稿虚称支持秒数截断，交原代理改成实际固定迭代后完整重跑。
source_review.limits: 未验证1915的计算下界证明，未重跑2008并行GES或2025长时solver；2006只是可行公开纪录，不称最优。
